+    return obs

+def submit_joint(actions, dt=0.1, tag='action', interpolate='linear'):

+
+def submit_ee(poses, tag='ee'):
+    res = R.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), video='mp4', note=tag)
